integrity: The proof independently derives the componentwise trace pairing, its nondegeneracy over each finite field, the three support-dependent kernel sizes, the exact degree set, and the reconstruction formulas. A standalone checker enumerates trace-functional kernels and resulting degrees over several prime and non-prime finite fields.
scientific_limitations: The reconstruction theorem is restricted to exactly two finite-field factors with the same matrix size.
The local degree formula is compatible with and partly motivated by the established general degree formula for trace graphs over finite commutative rings.
Public full text for the 2018 and 2021 Springer papers was unavailable through the checked routes; their relevant statements were inspected as reproduced in the full 2024 survey.
title: Trace graphs recover both factors of a two-field semisimple ring
